slice.title: Basic note management
slice.goal: Build the initial notes application prototype: list notes, create notes, edit notes, and search notes by text using local JSON mock storage.
acceptance_criteria: User can see a list of notes.
User can edit an existing note.
User can search notes by text.
The main screen and interactive controls have stable data-prototype-id anchors linked to scheme elements.
The prototype uses local JSON mock storage and does not require external integrations.
constraints: Use local JSON mock storage from the sample mock plan.
No new dependencies beyond the selected kit.

notes: This is the canonical greenfield baseline scenario used after cloning or moving the project.
The scheme_model.json in this sample describes the intended initial prototype scheme for SLICE-001.
